description: FinCEN Travel Rule Compliance — generates and transmits Travel Rule records for cross-border payments over $3,000. Creates a FATF R16-compliant record with originator and beneficiary identity data, transaction details, and a cryptographic attestation. Returns a Travel Rule ID for the audit trail. Accepts the same settlement parameters as settlement.execute — use after oracle and compliance gates pass. Can also receive inbound Travel Rule records from counterparty VASPs. Free (included in settlement flow; standalone record creation available).

beneficiaryName.description: Legal name of beneficiary entity. Optional if LEI provided.

originatorName.description: Legal name of originator entity. Optional if LEI provided.

name: integration.travel_rule

travelRuleId.description: FATF R16 Travel Rule record ID.
